comparison.objective: Vent a vacuum desiccator gradually, hold its dome, load a vial, reseal, evacuate, isolate, and verify the seal.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered valve modulation, bimanual dome holding and vial placement, switch operation, and seal checking versus precision impact tooling and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Venting below 12 kPa/s, vial upright, dome centered, vacuum at or below -90 kPa, stopcock shut, pump off, and seal retained versus four contained fractures without insert damage.
comparison.reason: The lengthy process-control task has no controlled fracture or debris-accounting outcome.
